### Given
\[
G_p(s)=\frac{2\,e^{-1.5s}}{(6s+1)(2s+1)(s+1)},\quad 
G_v(s)=1,\quad 
G_m(s)=\frac{1}{0.5s+1}
\]
\[
L(s)=G_c(s)G_v(s)G_p(s)G_m(s)
\]
For \(s=i\omega\), dead time contributes phase \(-\omega\theta\) (radians), magnitude \(1\).

Process+sensor frequency response:
\[
G_p(i\omega)G_m(i\omega)=
\frac{2e^{-i1.5\omega}}{(1+i6\omega)(1+i2\omega)(1+i\omega)(1+i0.5\omega)}
\]
Magnitude:
\[
|G_pG_m|=\frac{2}{\sqrt{(1+(6\omega)^2)(1+(2\omega)^2)(1+\omega^2)(1+(0.5\omega)^2)}}
\]
Phase (continuous, starting at \(0\) at \(\omega=0\)):
\[
\angle(G_pG_m)= -\Big[\tan^{-1}(6\omega)+\tan^{-1}(2\omega)+\tan^{-1}(\omega)+\tan^{-1}(0.5\omega)+1.5\omega\Big]
\]

---

## (a) Ultimate frequency \(\omega_u\) for proportional-only control
With \(G_c=K_c\), the phase condition for \(-180^\circ\) is:
\[
\tan^{-1}(6\omega)+\tan^{-1}(2\omega)+\tan^{-1}(\omega)+\tan^{-1}(0.5\omega)+1.5\omega=\pi
\]
Solving numerically gives:
\[
\omega_u \approx 0.423\ \text{rad/min}
\]

---

## (b) Ultimate gain \(K_u\) and ultimate period \(P_u\)
At \(\omega_u\),
\[
K_u=\frac{1}{|G_p(i\omega_u)G_m(i\omega_u)|}
\]
Compute at \(\omega_u=0.423\):
- Denominator product:
\[
(1+(6\omega)^2)(1+(2\omega)^2)(1+\omega^2)(1+(0.5\omega)^2)
\approx 15.72
\]
\[
|G_pG_m|=\frac{2}{\sqrt{15.72}} \approx 0.504
\Rightarrow K_u \approx \frac{1}{0.504}=1.98
\]
Ultimate period:
\[
P_u=\frac{2\pi}{\omega_u}=\frac{6.283}{0.423}\approx 14.9\ \text{min}
\]

---

## (c) Ziegler–Nichols PID (ideal/parallel form)
ZN rules:
\[
K_c=0.6K_u,\quad \tau_I=\frac{P_u}{2},\quad \tau_D=\frac{P_u}{8}
\]
So:
\[
K_c=0.6(1.98)=1.19
\]
\[
\tau_I=\frac{14.9}{2}=7.43\ \text{min},\qquad
\tau_D=\frac{14.9}{8}=1.86\ \text{min}
\]
Controller:
\[
G_c(s)=K_c\left(1+\frac{1}{\tau_I s}+\tau_D s\right)
\]

---

## (d) Gain margin (ratio) and phase-crossover frequency \(\omega_{pc}\) for PID loop
For PID,
\[
G_c(i\omega)=K_c\left(1+\frac{1}{i\omega\tau_I}+i\omega\tau_D\right)
=K_c\left[1+i\left(\omega\tau_D-\frac{1}{\omega\tau_I}\right)\right]
\]
So
\[
\angle G_c(i\omega)=\tan^{-1}\!\left(\omega\tau_D-\frac{1}{\omega\tau_I}\right)
\]
Phase crossover condition (lowest \(\omega\) where \(\angle L=-\pi\), starting from \(-\pi/2\) at \(\omega\to0^+\)):
\[
\angle(G_pG_m)+\angle G_c=-\pi
\]
Solving numerically gives:
\[
\omega_{pc}\approx 0.585\ \text{rad/min}
\]
Magnitude at \(\omega_{pc}=0.585\):
\[
|G_pG_m|\approx 0.295,\quad 
|G_c|\approx K_c\sqrt{1+\left(\omega\tau_D-\frac{1}{\omega\tau_I}\right)^2}\approx 1.57
\]
\[
|L(i\omega_{pc})|\approx 0.462
\]
Gain margin (ratio):
\[
GM=\frac{1}{|L(i\omega_{pc})|}\approx \frac{1}{0.462}=2.16
\]

---

## (e) Phase margin and gain-crossover frequency \(\omega_{gc}\)
Gain crossover: solve \(|L(i\omega)|=1\). Numerical solution:
\[
\omega_{gc}\approx 0.284\ \text{rad/min}
\]
Phase at \(\omega_{gc}\):
- Process+sensor phase:
\[
\angle(G_pG_m)\approx -2.400\ \text{rad}=-137.5^\circ
\]
- Controller phase:
\[
\angle G_c \approx \tan^{-1}(0.053)\approx 0.053\ \text{rad}=3.0^\circ
\]
So
\[
\angle L(i\omega_{gc})\approx -134.5^\circ
\]
Phase margin:
\[
PM=180^\circ+\angle L(i\omega_{gc})\approx 180-134.5=45.5^\circ
\]

---

## (f) Maximum sensitivity \(M_s\) and frequency where it occurs
\[
S(i\omega)=\frac{1}{1+L(i\omega)},\qquad M_s=\max_{\omega>0}|S(i\omega)|
\]
Using
\[
|1+L|^2 = 1+|L|^2+2|L|\cos(\angle L)
\]
and scanning frequencies, the peak occurs around \(\omega\approx 0.46\ \text{rad/min}\), giving:
\[
M_s \approx 2.12 \quad \text{at}\quad \omega \approx 0.46\ \text{rad/min}
\]

---

FINAL (a): 0.423 rad/min  
FINAL (b): 1.98 dimensionless  
FINAL (c): 1.19 dimensionless  
FINAL (d): 2.16 dimensionless  
FINAL (e): 45.5 deg  
FINAL (f): 2.12 dimensionless
